lines.text: Many learners say: He said me the news.
Better: He told me the news.
Tell takes a person. Say does not.
Told! She told me a story.

data.why: Tell takes a person. Say does not.

native.tip: ‘나에게 말했다’를 said me로 옮기기 쉬워요. 사람이 바로 오면 told! 이렇게 말해요 👉 “He told me the news.”
native.caption: “He said me the news”처럼 말하고 있나요? 😅 say 뒤에는 사람을 바로 쓰지 않아요. 사람이 바로 올 때는 tell을 써요. 맞는 문장 ✅ “He told me the news.” Ama 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.
native.comment: 정답: “told”! 사람이 오면 tell! 무료 퀴즈로 더 연습해 보세요: {link}

en.tip: Say does not take a person right after it. Use tell: “He told me the news.”
en.caption: Do you say “He said me the news” in English? 😅 Say cannot take a person right after it, so use “tell”! “He told me the news” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
